author: goldenwalrus909
body:
Hey, Goldie here :3

So, I was recently playing on Divines and I really like the map. The only problem is the matches end way too quickly-- if you defend your team, your team wins and if you don't defend the other team ends up winning. It's really way too easy to get the monument. If you 1v1 someone (there's usually only 1 person defending) on top, near the monument, and you win, you're going to also win the game because no one can get up to the monument in time. All you have to do is cover yourself in blocks and you win way too quickly and easily. 
I think the best solution to this is to make multiple monuments in order to slow them down. I personally think the multiple monuments idea would work great because then the team knows they need to defend more and have a second chance while still keeping the fast-paced game-play. If you do something like decrease the pick-axe speed, the game-play would be pretty bad because once again, if you 1v1 and kill someone, you'll either win the game or, if the pickaxe is too slow, the guy can just run up to the monument and kill you which will make the game-play pretty slow and boring. 
What do you think about this? :3  
If you have any ideas, approval or criticism, please comment below! (:

I'd like more than one monument or even CTF like Kirby said :D
